title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) & Tractor Subsidy Guidelines
description: Official government guidelines for tractor and farm machinery subsidy schemes under SMAM and MahaDBT.
source_name: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / Department of Agriculture, Maharashtra
content:
Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) is a flagship scheme administered by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India, and state agriculture departments (such as MahaDBT in Maharashtra) to promote farm mechanization.

Key Benefits & Financial Assistance:
- Tractor Subsidy: Financial assistance ranging from 40% to 50% of the cost of tractors and agricultural equipment, subject to state specific caps and category guidelines.
- Beneficiary Categories: Preferential subsidy rates for small and marginal farmers, women farmers, and SC/ST farmers.
- Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs): Financial support for establishing Custom Hiring Centers through PACS, cooperative societies, and farmer self-help groups.

Eligibility Criteria:
1. Applicant must be an active farmer holding agricultural land (documented via 7/12 land extract and 8A record).
2. Applicant must not have availed a tractor subsidy under any central or state government scheme in the past 10 years.
3. Registration on the state Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) portal (e.g., MahaDBT in Maharashtra or AgriMachinery portal).

Required Documents:
1. 7/12 Land Extract and 8A Land Record.
2. Aadhaar Card (linked with bank account).
3. Bank Passbook copy showing IFSC code.
4. Official Quotation and Proforma Invoice from an authorized tractor dealer.
5. Caste Certificate (for SC/ST category applicants seeking higher subsidy rates).

Application Procedure:
1. Register and log in on the official State Agriculture Portal (e.g., https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in for Maharashtra or https://agrimachinery.nic.in).
2. Select 'Agricultural Mechanization Scheme' (कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण) under Farmer Schemes.
3. Fill in personal, land, and tractor specifications, upload required documents, and submit the online application.
4. Post-lottery selection and administrative approval, purchase the tractor from an authorized dealer and submit physical verification documents for direct benefit transfer.
